items.description: In the world of gaming, 2013 was a lifetime ago. Since Rockstar Games released their most recent Grand Theft Auto title, the console landscape has changed drastically, companies and gaming franchises have seen legendary comebacks, and we’re seeing crossovers that once felt impossible. Before we finally get our hands on Grand Theft Auto 6, let’s look back at some of the most unbelievable things that have happened in gaming before we got GTA 6.
